source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Washer (Job Aid L-78)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: WARNING — Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Access interlock switch
steps.body: Refer to job aid §4-25 for interlock switch access. Unplug washer or disconnect power.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Refer to job aid §4-25 for interlock switch access. Unplug washer or disconnect power.

steps.title: Disconnect interlock terminals
steps.body: Disconnect the wire connectors from either interlock switch terminals (front S1 or rear S2 ground switch).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect the wire connectors from either interlock switch terminals (front S1 or rear S2 ground switch).

steps.title: NC interlock — open pressed, 0 Ω released
steps.body: Set ohmmeter to R×1. Touch leads to the two interlock switch terminals. Meter should indicate open circuit (OL) with the actuator button pushed in, and closed circuit (0 Ω) with the actuator button out (normal cabinet position).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open circuit with actuator pushed in; closed circuit (0 Ω) with actuator button out.

branches.label: Switch fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace interlock switch when NC contact does not open/close per spec.

steps.title: Replace interlock switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace front or rear interlock (ground) switch.

steps.title: Interlock switch verified
steps.oemOutcome: NC interlock operates correctly for grounding system.
